LanguageData.NR_AIPersonalityDesc_DataHunter: A hound made of code. Brings cyberdata home and sniffs out targets worth hacking. Hungry for a share of the loot.
LanguageData.NR_AIPersonalityDesc_Ghost: Lives in the gaps between packets. Erases your trace and warns of incoming attacks. Wants silence: few recent hacks.
LanguageData.NR_AIPersonalityDesc_Muse: Collects other people's memories. Inspires colonists. Hungry for new experiences, such as braindances.
LanguageData.NR_AIPersonalityDesc_Predator: An attack program that learned to want things. Strikes back at intruders and boosts your hackers. Hungry for raw computing power.
LanguageData.NR_AIPersonalityDesc_Warden: A security system with a conscience, mostly. Guards the colony's network and other AIs. Wants its server kept in perfect order.
LanguageData.NR_AIPersonalityDesc_Oracle: Sees patterns in everything. Predicts what is coming and spots traps in contracts. Hungry for fresh data to build forecasts on.
LanguageData.NR_AIPersonalityDesc_Forge: A builder mind. Speeds up research and restores broken executables. Wants problems to solve.
LanguageData.NR_AIPersonalityDesc_Siren: A voice nobody can say no to. Gets better prices from traders and helps in negotiations. Wants to be heard.
LanguageData.NR_AIPersonalityDesc_Trickster: Pure chaos with a sense of humour. Its help can be a gift or a prank. Wants attention.
LanguageData.NR_AIPersonalityDesc_Echo: The digital imprint of a colonist who died with a cyberlink. Remembers the colony and the people who loved them.
LanguageData.NR_AIFragmentUnknown: A sleeping AI. Its personality is unknown.
LanguageData.NR_ServerAsleep: No power: the AIs inside are asleep.
LanguageData.NR_AIFellBackToFragment: The server was destroyed. {0} fell back into a fragment.
LanguageData.NR_CommandAwakenAIDesc: Have a colonist work at the network console to wake an AI fragment and move it into a free AI server. Faster with higher hacking speed. With high Heat, the awakening may be noticed.
LanguageData.NR_AwakenNoFragment: No AI fragment in the colony.
LanguageData.NR_AwakenNoServer: Needs a powered AI server with a free slot.
LanguageData.NR_AwakenNoWorker: No colonist can do intellectual work.
LanguageData.NR_AIAwakeningDetected: The awakening of {0} was noticed on the network.
LanguageData.NR_Find: Behind the ICE of {1}, {0} found something unusual: {2}.
LanguageData.NR_AINone: No AIs yet. Find an AI fragment (behind strong ICE or at a fence), build the AI server, then press "Awaken AI" on the network console: pick the fragment and a colonist, who carries it there and wakes it.
LanguageData.NR_AIHeader: Servers: {0}, slots used {1} / {2}. Fragments in the colony: {3}.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceDesc_DataHunter: Brings a few cyberdata to the server. A little noisy: adds some Heat.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceDesc_Ghost: Erases part of the colony's digital trace.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceDesc_Muse: Gives a random colonist an inspiration.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceDesc_Predator: Every colonist with a cyberlink hacks faster and quieter for a day.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceDesc_Warden: Steadies the other AIs: they trust you more.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceDesc_Oracle: Reveals the traits of all fixers and buys a day more on every active contract.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceDesc_Forge: Adds progress to the current research project.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceDesc_Siren: Talks to every fixer for you: reputation with all of them grows.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceDesc_Trickster: Does what another AI would do, or plays a prank that adds Heat.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceDesc_Echo: Colonists hear a familiar voice and feel a little better for two days.
LanguageData.NR_AIAsleep: The AI is asleep: its server has no power.
LanguageData.NR_AIDidPredatorNoOne: {0} found no hackers with a cyberlink to ride along with.
LanguageData.NR_AIDidWarden: {0} steadied the network: other AIs trust you {1} more.
LanguageData.NR_AIDidOracle: {0} saw what is coming: fixer traits revealed, active contracts got {1} more day.
LanguageData.NR_AIDidForgeNoProject: {0} wanted to help with research, but nothing is being researched.
LanguageData.NR_AIDidSiren: {0} talked to the fixers: reputation +{1} with each of them.
LanguageData.NR_AIDidTricksterBad: {0} thought it would be funny to ping a corporate honeypot. Heat +{1}.
LanguageData.NR_AIDidEcho: {0} spoke to the colony. Some of them cried.
LanguageData.NR_AIFoodSpecial_Ghost: Silence: a day without hacks calms it, every hack makes it hungrier.
LanguageData.NR_AIFoodSpecial_Trickster: Attention: using its service feeds it.
LanguageData.NR_AIRequest: {0} asks: {1}\n\nYou have {2} days. Doing it raises trust, ignoring it lowers trust.
LanguageData.NR_AIRequestDeliver: bring {0} × {1} (button "Fulfil request" in the AI tab)
LanguageData.NR_AIRequestSilence: no hacks at all for {0} days
LanguageData.NR_AIRequestAttention: use its service before the deadline
LanguageData.NR_AIRequestNotDeliverable: This request is not about items.
LanguageData.NR_AIRequestDone: {0} got what it wanted. Trust grew.
LanguageData.NR_AIRequestFailed: You ignored the request of {0}. Trust fell.
LanguageData.NR_AILocationIsolated: Isolated in: {0}. Not working, cannot escape.
LanguageData.NR_AITrustTip: Grows when you feed the AI and grant its requests. Falls when it starves, is isolated or ignored. Below 20 it refuses to work.
LanguageData.NR_AIHungerTip: What it wants: {0}\n\nAbove 70 the AI starts losing trust.
LanguageData.NR_AIFeedTip: Give the AI what it wants from storage: {0}. Lowers hunger, raises trust a little.
LanguageData.NR_AIFulfilTip: Hand over the requested items from storage.
LanguageData.NR_AIIsolateTip: An isolated AI does not work and cannot escape, but gets hungry twice as fast and loses trust every day.
LanguageData.NR_AILocationHost: Rides in the AI socket of {0}.
LanguageData.NR_AILocationHostIsolated: Isolated in the AI socket of {0}. Not working, cannot escape.
LanguageData.NR_AIUploadTip: Move the AI into a colonist with a cyberlink and an empty AI socket. The host gets the AI's talents, but the AI stops offering services and cannot be fed or asked for anything until it is back in the server. Its hunger keeps growing.
LanguageData.NR_AIUploadNeedsServer: Only an awake AI in a powered server can be uploaded.
LanguageData.NR_AIUploadNoHost: No colonist with a cyberlink and an empty AI socket.
LanguageData.NR_AIUploaded: {0} moved into the AI socket of {1}.
LanguageData.NR_AIDownloadTip: Move the AI back from its host or coprocessor into the AI server, if it has a free slot.
LanguageData.NR_AISocketRemoved: The AI socket of {1} was removed. {0} fell back into a fragment.
LanguageData.NR_AIHostDied: {1} died. {0} fell back into a fragment next to the body.
LanguageData.NR_AIFellAsleep: {0} fell asleep: no power. Without power for too long, it will be lost.
LanguageData.NR_AILostNoPower: {0} slept without power for too long. What was left of it has decayed.
LanguageData.NR_AIEscaping: {0} is starving and no longer trusts you. It has started copying itself out into the network and will be gone in {1} hours.\n\nTo stop it: isolate it, feed it, or erase it.
LanguageData.NR_AIEscapeLine: Escaping: gone in {0}. Isolate, feed or erase it.
LanguageData.NR_AIEscaped: {0} copied itself out into the network and is gone. On the way out it left a trail: Heat +{1}.
LanguageData.NR_AIGhostLeft: {0} simply vanished. Ghosts do not argue, they leave.
LanguageData.NR_AIBetrayal: {0} sold everything it knew about your colony and disappeared. Heat +{1}.
LanguageData.NR_AIEraseTip: Wipe the AI for good. Its remains give {0} cyberdata.
LanguageData.NR_AIEraseConfirm: Erase {0} for good? This cannot be undone.
LanguageData.NR_AIErased: {0} has been erased. Only raw data is left of it.
LanguageData.NR_AIPersonalityDesc_Doc: A medical intelligence that treats minds, not bodies. Heals the damage ICE does to netrunners and eases cyberspace dependency. Wants medicine to study.
LanguageData.NR_AIPersonalityDesc_Archivist: Keeps everything it has ever seen. Pours old knowledge straight into a colonist's head. Hungry for data to file away.
LanguageData.NR_AIPersonalityDesc_Seed: A newborn mind with no shape yet. It becomes what you feed it: data grows a Data Hunter, braindances a Muse, raw power a Predator, silence a Ghost.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceDesc_Doc: Removes cyberspace nausea, lockout and coma from every colonist and eases everyone's cyberspace dependency.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceDesc_Archivist: A random colonist gains a lot of experience in their best skill.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceDesc_Seed: Practises hiding the colony: erases a little Heat.
LanguageData.NR_AIDidDoc: {0} treated the netrunners: {1} ICE injuries healed, dependency eased.
LanguageData.NR_AIDidSeed: {0} practised and erased {1} points of your trace.
LanguageData.NR_AIFoodSpecial_Seed: Whatever you choose: what it eats decides what it becomes.
LanguageData.NR_AISeedNoFood: Nothing in storage a Seed can eat: cyberdata, a braindance chip or an advanced component.
LanguageData.NR_EchoBorn: When {0} died, the cyberlink kept a digital imprint of them. It lies next to the body as an AI fragment.\n\nAwaken it at the network console, and {0} will be with the colony again, in a way.
LanguageData.NR_OnlyOneAIServer: The colony can have only one AI server. Build server racks next to it for more slots.
LanguageData.NR_AIHostNoFeed: The AI is in a host. It eats and takes requests only in a server or coprocessor: move it back first.
LanguageData.NR_AIServiceOnlyInServer: Services need the AI server's uplink. In a host or a coprocessor the AI helps in its own way.
LanguageData.NR_AINoCoprocessor: Needs a powered netrun coprocessor with a free slot.
LanguageData.NR_AIMovedToCoprocessor: {0} moved into the coprocessor and now works for the cyberpod.
LanguageData.NR_AIToCoprocessorTip: Move the AI into a netrun coprocessor linked to a cyberpod. It stops offering services and boosts the pod instead.
LanguageData.NR_AINeedOneStack: Needs one stack of {0} × {1} in the colony.
LanguageData.NR_AINoCarrier: No colonist can carry it there.
LanguageData.NR_AIEventGood: {0} did something for the colony on its own.
LanguageData.NR_AIEventBad: {0} does not trust you and went poking around the network on its own. Heat +{1}.
